hash.description: The hash the work was computed for, echoed.

work.description: The 8-byte work value, hex, valid for hash at threshold.

threshold.description: The threshold the work reaches: fffffff800000000, the Nano send threshold.

source.description: Which worker computed it (gpu, node, or a precomputed pool).

paid.description: Whether this call was paid (true) or within the free allowance (false).
